tasks.title: Footprint guard lets 4-high canopies through outside footprints
tasks.notes: Found in bake-off R-008: osm_footprints.guard() exempts anything <= BACK_RISE=4 outside the front zone (meant for garden sheds), so parasol canopies (red_concrete, 4 above ground) on open mapped ground between SUSU and the Retail Centre passed; no footprint-hits file was written and plan.outside_footprint_ok was never consulted. Fix options: treat roof-like blocks (concrete, slabs) as building-like at any height outside footprints, or add an explicit furniture category so open-ground furniture is allowed on purpose. Add a unit test. See model-bakeoffs/rounds/R-008.json why-block.
